blocks.text: MANILA — House prosecution panel spokespersons on Monday challenged Vice President Sara Z. Duterte to substantiate her claim that the Marcos administration was to blame for the South Cotabato school shooting. Duterte had issued a statement that the Marcos administration is focused on political consolidation and survival instead of protecting the public. “But this should not be blamed on the present administration. Dahil una-una, kung magbibitaw ka ng ganyang salita, ano ang basehan mo? Ano ang iyong ebidensya (Because first, if you are going to make that kind of statement, what is your basis?
